question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a black present, Bob has a brown present, Claire has a yellow present, Dave has a pink present, Eve has a white present, Fred has a blue present, and Gertrude has a silver present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Gertrude and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Gertrude and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Gertrude and Eve swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Gertrude and Dave swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Dave swap their gifts. Finally, Bob and Alice swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Alice has the
Options:
(A) black present
(B) brown present
(C) yellow present
(D) pink present
(E) white present
(F) blue present
(G) silver present
solution:
Gift colors in each row are listed in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: black, brown, yellow, pink, white, blue, silver.
1. Gertrude and Fred swap: black, brown, yellow, pink, white, silver, blue.
2. Gertrude and Bob swap: black, blue, yellow, pink, white, silver, brown.
3. Gertrude and Eve swap: black, blue, yellow, pink, brown, silver, white.
4. Eve and Alice swap: brown, blue, yellow, pink, black, silver, white.
5. Gertrude and Dave swap: brown, blue, yellow, white, black, silver, pink.
6. Claire and Dave swap: brown, blue, white, yellow, black, silver, pink.
7. Bob and Alice swap: blue, brown, white, yellow, black, silver, pink.
Alice has the blue present, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
